sentences.text: In January 2021, we entered into a credit agreement (the "2021 Credit Agreement"), which provides for a five-year $7.5 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, of which $500 million is available for the issuance of multi-currency letters of credit.
We had no borrowings outstanding under the revolving credit facility at either November 3, 2024 or October 29, 2023.
The Company has $3 billion available under a revolving credit agreement, as amended, that expires on April 29, 2027 (Revolving Credit Agreement).
As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, the Company had no outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Agreement.

comparisons.peer_topic: Revolving Credit Facility Limits and Maturities
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, the company expanded its 5-year $5.0 billion and 364-day $5.0 billion revolving credit facilities to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion respectively, with maturity dates extended to February 2029 and January 2025. These facilities are unsecured general obligations and had no borrowings outstanding as of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both Broadcom and Intel report having no outstanding borrowings under their respective unsecured revolving credit facilities at the end of fiscal year 2024. Intel expanded its facilities in 2024 to $7.0 billion (5-year) and $8.0 billion (364-day), whereas Broadcom maintained a single $7.5 billion five-year facility entered into in 2021. Intel’s facility includes both 5-year and 364-day tranches, while Broadcom’s is a single five-year revolving facility.

sentences.text: In January 2021, we entered into a credit agreement (the "2021 Credit Agreement"), which provides for a five-year $7.5 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, of which $500 million is available for the issuance of multi-currency letters of credit.

In 2024, we expanded both our 5-year $5.0 billion revolving credit facility agreement and our 364-day $5.0 billion credit facility agreement, to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion, respectively, and the maturity dates were extended by one year to February 2029 and January 2025, respectively.
The revolving credit facilities had no borrowings outstanding as of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023.

comparisons.peer_topic: Revolving Credit Facility Availability and Status
comparisons.peer_summary: As of August 29, 2024, no amounts were outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility, with $2.50 billion available. The facility matures in May 2026, and borrowed amounts may be prepaid without penalty.
comparisons.comparison: Both Broadcom and Micron report no outstanding borrowings under their unsecured revolving credit facilities at the end of fiscal year 2024. Broadcom’s facility has a $7.5 billion limit and matures in January 2026, while Micron’s facility has a $2.50 billion available limit (implying the same total availability if undrawn) and matures in May 2026. Both companies emphasize their ability to access liquidity without current debt.
